body:
Thank you for this clear write-up, @FlamingFireCoding. Engraved part numbers are a common need, and the plan reuses the right parts (Sketch, the Engrave/Trace generator, `face_frame`, the mark law).

Triage: `enhancement`, `P6` (accepted, not scheduled), `effort:high` (new toolpath input that reaches posted G-code, so the safety floor applies), `area:2d`. If the maintainer wants it for the next release, he can raise it to `P4` with his own words quoted here.

Clean-room notes:
- Glyph outlines must come only from a font that we already bundle under a permissive licence (`assets/ui/fonts/`, see `assets/ui/LICENSES.md`); no letter shapes or engraving fonts from another CAM product.
- Record the first ride mode (outline or single-line) in `docs/decisions/`, as the issue says.

What would help: one or two example parts with the text you want (string, height, face), and the tool you would use (v-bit angle or end mill size). A safe air cut, or a cut in wax or foam, is the best first test when it is ready.
